research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Databricks is researching unified data and AI infrastructure focused on scalable data processing, lakehouse table management, and machine learning workflows. Work such as Pipelined execution of database queries processing streaming data, Multi-cluster query result caching, Auto maintenance for data tables in cloud storage, Feature Store with Integrated Tracking, Model ml registry and model serving, and Training machine learning transformer architectures with hybrid moving average shows efforts in streaming SQL, table optimization, feature and model management, and transformer and language model training. Together these target streaming analytics, data governance, and ML lifecycle management.

overview_description.description: Databricks offers a cloud platform that unifies data engineering, warehousing, analytics, and AI workflows. It applies a lakehouse approach to support data ingestion, transformation, and governance alongside development and deployment of machine learning and generative AI models. The platform includes features like ETL orchestration, serverless SQL analytics, data sharing across environments, notebook-based collaboration, model training, model registry, and application development tools. Databricks also maintains several open-source projects, including Delta Lake, MLflow, and the DBRX large language model, and it continues to integrate AI-driven enhancements such as test-time adaptive model optimization.
